decisions.reason: As a recent adjacent automation product that fits the firm's digital efficiency strategy in a growing market, it is likely to be retained while management allows time for project-based adoption.

The web tool is strategically related to the engineering offer and likely inexpensive to maintain, but as a narrower niche application it faces a somewhat higher chance of withdrawal if usage falls short of aspirations.

This system builds directly on the firm's established solution business and supports customer efficiency goals, so an expanding R&D-oriented firm would usually keep it unless early market feedback is clearly disappointing.
